foot.not_advice: It is not medical advice. It cannot diagnose, and nothing here should start, stop or change a medicine without your own care team. Criteria, screening tools and the lithium level explainer are for learning, not self-diagnosis or reading your own results. Doses, levels and monitoring schedules are quoted as published in labels and guidelines, never as instructions; suspected lithium toxicity is an emergency. Please check the original sources, which are listed in full in the Sources module.
shell.disclaimer: The Bipolar Companion is an educational synthesis of published literature for study and understanding. It does not replace a psychiatrist, nurse, pharmacist or other clinician. The criteria counter, screening tools and lithium level explainer are teaching aids, not self-tests, and doses and lithium levels are quoted as published, never as instructions. Suspected lithium toxicity is an emergency. If you are in crisis or thinking about suicide, contact local emergency services or a crisis line (in the US call or text 988; in the UK and Ireland Samaritans 116 123).
shell.note: An animated, cited guide for students, people living with bipolar disorder, and their families and carers. Educational only, not medical advice. Your place is saved on this device.
